description_en: Submits a live stream transcoding job
description_zh: 调用本接口提交实时转码任务
kebab_example: aliyun ice submit-live-transcode-job --name task1 --template-id 000096e8864746a0b6f30000 --start-mode 0 --stream-input Type=rtmp InputUrl=rtmp://mydomain/app/stream1 --transcode-output Type=LiveCenter DomainName=mydomain --timed-config EndTime=2022-07-20T08:20:32Z StartTime=2022-02-21T00:00:00Z --region cn-hangzhou
name: SubmitLiveTranscodeJob

parameters.help_en: The name of the transcoding job
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The start mode of the transcoding job.

- 0: The transcoding job immediately starts.

- 1: The transcoding job starts at the scheduled time
parameters.help_zh:
启动模式。

- 0 - 立即启动
- 1 - 定时启动
parameters.name: start_mode

fields.help_en: The type of the input stream. The value can only be rtmp
fields.help_zh: 流输入类型。目前只支持rtmp
fields.name: type

fields.help_en: The URL of the input stream
fields.name: input_url

parameters.help_en: The information about the input stream
parameters.name: stream_input

fields.help_en: The type of the output stream. A value of LiveCenter indicates that the URL of the output stream is generated based on the domain name of ApsaraVideo Live. The value can only be LiveCenter
fields.help_zh:
输出流类型。
LiveCenter：阿里云视频直播域名生成地址

> 目前只支持LiveCenter
fields.name: type

fields.help_en: The streaming domain name of ApsaraVideo Live
fields.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The information about the transcoding output
parameters.name: transcode_output

fields.help_en: The start time of the transcoding job. Note: The time span between the start time and the current time cannot exceed seven days
fields.help_zh:
转码任务启动时间。
><notice>启动时间与当前时间的跨度不可超过7天。></notice>
fields.name: start_time

fields.help_en: The stop time of the transcoding job. Note: The time span between the stop time and the current time cannot exceed seven days
fields.help_zh:
转码任务停止时间。
><notice>停止时间与当前时间的跨度不可超过7天。></notice>
fields.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The configuration of a timed transcoding job. This parameter is required if you set StartMode to 1
parameters.help_zh:
定时任务配置。
当StartMode=1时该参数必填
parameters.name: timed_config
